en_before: Compared with Model Off-Duty, this Downtown Girl interpretation emphasizes more washed or layered surfaces. Beside Indie Sleaze, it has a less nightlife-focused starting point. Compared with Clean Girl, it makes more use of visibly textured denim and knitwear. These are overlapping editorial distinctions, not rules for people or bodies.
